entries.description: An MCP server for discovering NASA Earth science data. Its tools search the Common Metadata Repository (CMR) for collections, granules, services, tools, variables, and citations, and NASA's Keyword Management System (KMS) for official GCMD vocabulary, so an agent can find a dataset, confirm data exists for a given time and place, and identify how to access it.
representativeQueries: is there MODIS data covering Iceland for July 2023
what is the official GCMD keyword for rainfall
what subsetting or OPeNDAP services are available for the GEDI L2A collection
which variables are in the SMAP L3 soil moisture product, and what are their fill values
what tools can visualize MODIS vegetation indices
what papers cite the GRACE mascon dataset
